note: Facts only (sizes, counts, stock, hardware) recorded from public free plans and standards; no plan text or images copied. See SOURCES.md.

scoring.axes: overall_in.w = left-right facing the front (bed: across the mattress); d = front-back (bed: head to foot); h = floor to top. Compare with Yard project.overall {width, depth, height}.
scoring.dims_rule: Score an axis only when its value is not null. If the prompt types the axis, Yard's own I8 already demands +/-1/8 in; this key still uses the confidence tolerance so a plan's rounding is not a failure.
scoring.part_count_rule: Compare with the number of cut parts in Yard's cut list (bought hardware excluded). Plans count each board; Yard may count a glued-up top as one part, so this is a soft signal: report the ratio, fail only outside tolerance.
scoring.stock_rule: Pass when Yard's primary material family matches any listed stock family (plywood / dimensional lumber 2x / board 1x / cedar picket / hardwood).
scoring.hardware_rule: For each hardware item with a kind other than screw-*, nail-*, staple, none-slides: Yard's Buy list must contain that kind (qty checked when given, +/-0). 'none-slides' means Yard must NOT buy drawer slides.
scoring.standards_rule: Each standard lists the build types it applies to and, where given, a check. Mattress standards apply to every bed/bunk/loft prompt that names a size.
